citations.claim: EW green active, NS wait 62s triggers recall consideration
EW yellow last second before illegal transition
first violation: EW red after only 4s yellow, violates yellow_seconds=6

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated from true to false only; yellow then lasts full 6s, removing violation, proving actuated recall truncates yellow

explanation: EW green ends at step 183, EW yellow starts at 184. NS has waited 62s with large queues, so actuated recall is active. Controller incorrectly allows recall to abort EW yellow, transitioning to all-red at 188 after only 4s of yellow (steps 184-187) instead of required 6s yellow_seconds. Fixed-time same scenario does not violate.
vision_note: Steps 185-187 show the EW approaches yellow while NS is red, then at step 188 all four approaches are red. The EW yellow is aborted after only ~3-4 seconds visible, switching to all-red instead of completing the required 6s yellow.
